title: Asamiya Sahityar Buranji Vol. 1
author: Bisweswar Hazarika & ABILAC
genre: Scholarly Epigraphy & Pre-Modern Literary History of Assam
description: Exhaustive collaborative volume published by the Anundoram Borooah Institute of Language, Art & Culture (ABILAC), Guwahati, providing comprehensive philological examination of pre-modern epigraphs, early Tai-Ahom and Khamyang historical manuscripts, religious folios, and the formative phases of Eastern Indo-Aryan and Southwestern Tai writing systems.
